Date February 8, 1938.

Subject ......... arrest of members of the Peoples' National Salvation
Dramatic Group in the French Concession and the Settlement.
Made by ......... J.S. Pitts. ......... Forwarded by C. Crawford T.S.

With reference to the contents of the attached report
from Chen:tu Road Station and the translation of the French
Police Report on the same subject, I have to state that in
connection with FAN MANG ( 萬猛 ) alias ZAH FOH MING
( 柴福民 ), eventually released by the French Police
through lack of proof, a thorough search of his room at No.
54 Tamsui Road failed to reveal the slightest indication
that he was affiliated in any way with any political assoc-
iation. Intensive questioning of the other residents of
the premises regarding this person's suspected anti-Japanese
activities brought nothing to light, whilst his interrogation
at the hands of the French Police also failed to show that
he was a member of the Peoples' National Salvation Dramatic
Group. In this direction it should be mentioned that
TSONG TAI TSIEU ( 鍾淡秋 ) and II PING ( 李彬 ), both
arrested at the Customs Club, Bubbling Well Road, did not
implicate FAN MANG as being connected with the Dramatic Group
when they were being questioned by either the Municipal

( 薛仁 ), the self-confessed editor and printer of the
anti-Japanese pamphlets seized at No. 1960 Avenue Joffre.

TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT NO. 2421/1 DATED 5.2.38.

SUBJECT: Arrest of three members of the "People's National
Salvation Dramatic Group" (人民救国演剧队).

On February 4 we were informed by the Settlement Police
that one SIH JEN (  ), a member of an anti-Japanese
organisation, had had printed certain anti-Japanese pamphlets
and that certain of them were to be found in his room at
1960 Avenue Joffre.

We immediately raided this address, where the person
SIH JEN was arrested and 300 pamphlets of four different
types (translations attached) were seized.

STATEMENT OF SIH JEN

My name is SIH JEN, 20, native of Tsingpu (Kiangsu). For
two years I have been working for the China Economics Research
Society (中国经济统计研究所), 1960 Avenue Joffre, where I
reside. Miss TSANG SIAO MEI (张小梅) is the manager of
this society.

Towards the end of August 1937 I joined the Peoples'
National Salvation Dramatic Group, the offices of which were
located at 4 Kao Foh Li, Route des Soeurs. At present this
house is occupied by one TSANG YUEH (张月), former telephone
clerk at the Shanghai China Merchants' Stock Exchange Co.,
422 Hankow Road. He is now unemployed. At present the group
comprises some twenty members, who are directed by FU KUO
SHUN (傅国顺) alias IAC FU (雅夫).

After the fall of Shanghai, the majority of members,
including FU left for Hankow. Only four of us remain in
Shanghai - FAN MANG (万猛), alias ZAU FAH PONG (柴福庞),
LI PING (李彬), Miss TSANG TAI TSIEU (钟淡秋) and
myself. I do not know the numbers of the houses in which
the other members reside, but I know their whereabouts be-
cause I have often been to the premises.

1938年2月5日第2421/1号法国警察报告译文。

主题：逮捕“人民救国演剧队”（人民救国演剧队）三名成员。

2月4日，我们接到租界警方通知，称某反日组织成员薛仁（SIH JEN）（  ）印刷了某些反日传单，且其中部分可在其位于霞飞路1960号的房间内找到。

我们立即突袭了该地址，逮捕了薛仁其人，并缴获了四种不同类型的传单共300份（附译文）。

薛仁的供词

我叫薛仁，20岁，江苏青浦人。两年来，我一直在中国经济统计研究所（中国经济统计研究所）工作，地址为霞飞路1960号，我也居住于此。张小梅（TSANG SIAO MEI）小姐是该所的经理。

1937年8月底，我加入了“人民救国演剧队”，其办事处位于修女院路（Route des Soeurs）高福里4号。目前该房屋由张月（TSANG YUEH）占用，他原是汉口路422号上海华商证券交易所的电话接线员。现失业。目前该团体约有二十名成员，由傅国顺（FU KUO SHUN）领导，又名雅夫（IAC FU）。

上海沦陷后，包括傅在内的多数成员前往汉口。仅剩我们四人留在上海——范猛（FAN MANG），又名柴福庞（ZAU FAH PONG），李彬（LI PING），钟淡秋（TSANG TAI TSIEU）小姐和我自己。我不知道其他成员居住的门牌号码，但我知道他们的下落，因为我常去那些地方。

page_data.en:
2

The pamphlets found in my room were printed by me on a
roneo machine belonging to the Society for which I work.
(Three machines were seized at 1960 Avenue Joffre).
1200 copies of the pamphlet, which was edited by me,
were printed and distributed to my three friends. They, in
turn, passed them to their friends.
Since August 1937 I have printed two lots of tracts.
The first time - towards the end of October - I printed
about a thousand and handed them to my friends for distribution -
the second - about January 15 - are those which you seized.

As a result of this statement we made our way, accompanied
by SIH JEN, to the homes of TSONG TAI TSIEU and LI PING -
9 Ta Kong Li, Rue Eugene Bard and 17 Ki Yih Li, Rue Auguste
Boppe, respectively. At these premises we could only locate
the parents who insisted that the persons for whom we were
seeking had gone to take part in a theatrical show at the
Customs Club, 10, Lane 479 Bubbling Well Road.
With the assistance of D.S. PITTS (Special Branch), we
arrested at the address indicated TSONG TAO TSIEU and LI
PING, who were handed over to us.

STATEMENT OF TSONG TAI TSIEU (female)
My name is TSONG TAI TSIEU, 18, native of Hankow,
residing at 9 Ta Kong Li, Rue Eugene Bard with my mother,
brother and sister-in-law. My father, TSONG HAN CHIEH
(鍾漢傑), was the sub-prefect in Fufeng (扶風),
Shensi. He is now unemployed and remains in this town.
My brother TSONG KO SZE (鍾可治) is also unemployed.
In August 1937, 'shortly after the commencement of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities, I joined the Peoples' National
Salvation Dramatic Group, the offices of which were located
at 4 Kao Foh Li, Route des Soeurs. This group was dissolved
after the fall of Shanghai, and the majority of members left
for Shanghai. Some members (5 or 6) who have jobs here,
page_data.zh:
2

在我房间里发现的传单是我使用我所任职社团的一台油印机印刷的。（在霞飞路1960号缴获了三台机器）。
由我编辑的这份传单印刷了1200份，并分发给了我的三位朋友。他们又将其转交给各自的朋友。
自1937年8月以来，我印刷了两批小册子。第一次——10月底左右——我印刷了约一千份，交给朋友们分发——第二次——约1月15日——即你们查获的那些。

根据这份供词，我们在薛仁的陪同下，分别前往钟淡秋和李彬的住所——尤金·巴德路（Rue Eugene Bard）大康里9号和奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）基义里17号。在这些住所，我们只找到了他们的父母，他们坚称我们要找的人已前往静安寺路479弄10号的海关俱乐部参加戏剧演出。
在特务科警司 PITTS 的协助下，我们在上述地址逮捕了钟淡秋（TSONG TAO TSIEU，注：此处原文拼写与前文 TsonG Tai Tsieu 略有差异，依原文译）和李彬，并将他们移交给我们要。

钟淡秋女士的供词
我叫钟淡秋，18岁，汉口市人，与母亲、兄弟及嫂嫂居住在尤金·巴德路大康里9号。我的父亲钟汉杰（TSONG HAN CHIEH）曾任陕西扶风（扶風）县佐。现失业，留居该县。我的哥哥钟可治（TSONG KO SZE）也失业。
1937年8月，中日战事爆发后不久，我加入了“人民救国演剧队”，其办事处位于修女院路高福里4号。上海沦陷后该团体解散，多数成员离开上海。部分有工作的成员（5或6人），

page_data.en:
3

have remained in Shanghai. During January 1938, one
LI PING, a member of the group, sent me about ten copies
of a patriotic pamphlet, requesting me to read them and
then distribute them among my friends. At present there
are no pamphlets of this kind at my home.

STATEMENT OF LI PING

My name is LI PING, 22, native of Hankow, residing at
17 Ki Yih Li, Rue Auguste Joppe. I am employed by the
Co-operative Society of the Agricultural Bank of Kiangsu
(江蘇農民銀行合作社), located at this address, and I earn
$18 per month. I live alone in Shanghai.

Through the medium of one SUN FANG ( **〔此处转录不清〕** ), now in
Hankow, I joined, in August 1937, the Peoples' National
Salvation Dramatic Group, which then had its offices at
4 Kao Foh Li, Route des Soeurs. After I had joined the
group I came into contact with SIH JEN.

In January 1938 SIH JEN gave me, for the first time,
several patriotic leaflets. After having read them, I
distributed them in the streets. Towards the end of the
lunar year, SIH gave me another twenty pamphlets of the
same type. I then gave some of them to my friend TSONG
TAI TSIEU and tore-up the remainder.

Since the dissolution of the group, I have not become
a member of any patriotic organisation or any organisation
having political tendencies.

A raid made at 34 Tamsui Road, home of FAN MANG alias
ZAH FOH MING, gave no results. Further, the latter person
was absent. Mr. OU KOUANZE (吳匡時), a chemist, owner
of the laboratory situated at 561 Rue Lafayette, residing
at 101 Joffre Terrace, Avenue Joffre (Tel:72936), was
present at the house during the search. He guaranteed that
page_data.zh:
3

留在了上海。1938年1月间，该团体成员李彬寄给我约十份爱国小册子，请我阅读后在朋友中分发。目前我家中没有此类小册子。

李彬的供词

我叫李彬，22岁，汉口市人，居住在奥古斯特·乔佩路（Rue Auguste Joppe，注：前文为Boppe，此处OCR可能误读，依上下文应为同一路名）基义里17号。我就职于位于该地址的江苏农民银行合作社（江蘇農民銀行合作社），月薪18元。我在上海独自居住。

通过现在汉口的孙芳（SUN FANG）（ **〔此处转录不清〕** ）介绍，我于1937年8月加入了“人民救国演剧队”，当时其办事处位于修女院路高福里4号。加入该团体后，我与薛仁取得了联系。

1938年1月，薛仁首次给了我几份爱国传单。阅读后，我在街道上进行了分发。农历年底前后，薛又给了我二十份同类小册子。随后我将其中一些给了我的朋友钟淡秋，其余的则撕毁。

自该团体解散以来，我没有成为任何爱国组织或任何具有政治倾向组织的成员。

对范猛（又名柴福民）位于淡水路34号的住所进行的突袭未获结果。此外，此人不在家。化学家吴匡时（OU KOUANZE）先生，拉斐德路561号实验室所有者，居住在霞飞路霞飞坊101号（电话：72936），搜查时他在场。他保证

page_data.en:
4

he would bring FAN to the Political Section at 10 a.m. on
February 5 for interrogation.
At the stated time, Mr. OU KOUAN'ZE came to our
offices with the man for whom we were seeking.

STATEMENT OF FAN MANG ALIAS ZAH FOH MING
My name is ZAH FOH MING alias FAN MANG, 22, unemployed,
former student of the Shih Pei Municipal Secondary School,
Yung Shing Road, Chapei. I live at 34 Tamsui Road with
my parents. I am not a member of the Peoples' National
Salvation Dramatic Group. I have made the acquaintanceship
of SIH JEN through the medium of my school friends. SIH
JEN never gave me any pamphlets.

In view of the lack of proof against FAN he was
released, but the other three will be expelled from the
French Concession.

-------------
page_data.zh:
4

他将于2月5日上午10点带范到政治组接受讯问。
在指定时间，吴匡时先生带着我们要找的人来到我们的办公室。

范猛（又名柴福民）的供词
我叫柴福民，又名范猛，22岁，失业，前闸北永兴路市立中学学生。我与父母居住在淡水路34号。我不是“人民救国演剧队”成员。我是通过同学结识薛仁的。薛仁从未给过我任何传单。

鉴于缺乏针对范的证据，他已被释放，但其他三人将被驱逐出法租界。

Made by S.I. Lao Yen-ken Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

With reference to the report dated January 8, 1938,
on the subject of surreptitious distribution of anti-Japanese
handbills, further enquiries show that the present
organization comprising 20 members of the now defunct Youth's
National Salvation Service Group is known as the "People's
National Salvation Dramatic Group" ( 民眾救亡劇團 )
but has no definite address. They remained inactive after
the propaganda drive on January 5, 6 and 7, but resumed their
activities at the Lunar New Year. Five kinds of small
handbills of an anti-Japanese and national salvation nature
have been prepared and copies are being disseminated in a
secret manner. It is learned that during the past few days,
a number of copies were included in the programmes to be had
in Chinese cinemas and also thrown on to Nanking Road from
roof gardens.

Samples of four varieties have been obtained and are
herewith forwarded together with translations.

It is learned that the printing of these handbills
is done by one named Sih Jen ( 薛仁 ), a member of the
organization, and a staff employee of the China Economics
Research Society ( 中國經濟研究會 ), 1960 Avenue
Joffre, near Route Ferguson, and that other copies are at
present stored in his bed room at the same address.

Translation

Dear Brethren,

The Japanese robbers not only kill people
and occupy territory, but they also prohibit the Chinese
from having anti-Japanese ideas. We in all sincerity
tell her that "Those who are superior in armaments can
ruin the nation of others and enslave their people, but
they cannot, no matter how hard they try, subdue those
people nor their spirits.

Who said that we are disturbing the peace
of the people living in the Settlement ? Do you think
for one moment that after they robbed us of our Greater
Shanghai, we would let them enjoy it in peace ? Should
we allow those shameless traitors and running dogs to go
free who have sold our homes and our nation ? No. We
have made up our minds to struggle against them, to the
bitter end and until we recover our lost territory.

Sign of five circles in chain order.

No. 2.

译文

亲爱的同胞们：

日本强盗不仅杀人占地，还禁止中国人
拥有反日思想。我们真诚地告诉他们：“武器精良者
可以毁灭他国、奴役其人民，但无论他们如何努力，
都无法征服这些人民及其精神。”

谁说我们在扰乱租界居民的和平？你们是否
想过，在他们抢劫了我们的大上海之后，我们会让他们
安然享受吗？我们应该让那些出卖家园和国家的无耻
汉奸和走狗逍遥法外吗？不。我们已下定决心与他们
斗争到底，直到收复失地。

Dear Brethren in Shanghai,

The nation has undergone a change,
and the people in Shanghai ought to modify their attitude.
Ladies must banish all frivolous thoughts from their minds
and use their energy to the best advantage and not throw
it away on enjoyment. Ladies must undo the waves of
their hair, wash rouge and powder off their faces, take off
their high heeled shoes and become Chinese citizens of that
great nation of ours. If the hot blood of our brethren
cannot reach your sympathy and the guns of the enemy cannot
make you tense with excitement, then citizens as represented
by you are useless and no more than corpses.

We must live a life of hardship and
simplicity during the present national emergency. We must
be determined to recover our freedom on the field of battle.

Sign of five circles in chain order.
NO. 3.

亲爱的上海同胞们：

国家局势已变，上海市民应当改变态度。
女士们必须摒弃脑海中所有轻浮的念头，充分利用精力，
不要将其浪费在享乐上。女士们必须放下卷发，洗去
脸上的胭脂粉黛，脱下高跟鞋，成为我们伟大国家的
中国公民。如果同胞们的热血不能唤起你们的同情，
敌人的枪炮不能让你们紧张兴奋，那么作为公民代表的
你们就是无用的，不过是一具具尸体。

在当前国家紧急状态下，我们必须过艰苦朴素
的生活。我们必须决心在战场上夺回自由。

五个圆圈连环标志。
第3号。

page_data.en:
親愛的諸位同胞：

國家變樣子了，上海也應變樣子了！男子們
應該掃除頭腦中的一切雜念，再受多用力；女子們
應該淨直髮的洗去脂粉，脫去高跟鞋，大家硬
綳的做個大時代的中國人，假使同胞們和血還澆
不活你們的同情心，敵人的炮火還燒不緊張你們的生
命，亡國滅種簡直是國家的腐肉，
我們強烈要求政府去過着激化簡化的困難生
活，我們更重無產同志在流沙大戰場講身！

3.

- 3 -

Dear Brethren,

The Chinese race has been in existence for
five thousand years. The great nation, as it is to-day,
was brought into being by our ancestors. When the legacy
came into our possession, it was on the verge of destruction.
Who are the useless descendants of the ancestors? They
are the Chinese people of the present generation.

We must understand the fact that the present
hardships and tribulations we are now undergoing are the
outcome of our past failures, and that a new lease of life
can be obtained through victories in the battlefield. We
must repent of our past follies and in order to secure a
final victory, must believe that Japan will never be able
to conquer China. The worst thing, it is feared, is the
committing of further follies by us.

Sign of five circles in chain order.

No. 4.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

亲爱的同胞们：

中华民族已存在五千年。如今的伟大国家
是由我们的祖先建立的。当这份遗产传到我们手中时，
它已处于毁灭的边缘。谁是祖先的无用后裔？就是
当今一代的中国人。

我们必须认识到，我们现在所经历的艰难困苦
是我们过去失败的结果，而通过战场上的胜利可以获得
新生。我们必须忏悔过去的愚蠢行为，为了确保最终
的胜利，必须相信日本永远无法征服中国。最令人担忧
的坏事，恐怕是我们再犯愚蠢的错误。

五个圆圈连环标志。

第4号。

page_data.en:
親愛的同胞：

中華民族活了五千年，我們祖先在這塊土地上
優美、勤勞、胼手胝足，創造了這個偉大而光榮的國家，傳下了這
份無窮的產業，又遺傳到我們手裡，竟己破國滅種了。
祖宗業也喪蕩然，誰是我們祖先的沒出息的子孫？
就是現在活着的中國人！

我們現在應該徹底覺悟：這目前的慘敗教訓是
我們過去的失敗的收穫，今後的新的生命也惟有在
最後的勝利中取得，我們要悲憤圖強，奮鬥到底，我們要
爭取將來的勝利，我們確信日本不能亡掉中國，最
可怕的是我們自己糊塗！

To the Chinese traitors who have betrayed their country,

We have been forced to a point where life and death
is to be decided once and for all. If we advance, we
will be saved and if we retreat, we will be destroyed.
The bravery and deeds of the Chinese soldiers have achieved
a glorious name and have cowed the enemy, and have brought
into being again the national soul of the Chinese race.

Buried underneath the ground on which we stand are
the corpses of our ancestors. For the sake of a small
amount of money, you have actually betrayed your own
conscience and become shameless traitors. Are you really
willing to accelerate the extinction of your fatherland
by helping the enemy ? We are sure of overcoming the
enemy in the end, but we fear that the nation may suffer
defeats through your traitorous efforts.

It is not worth while for people of means to work
for the enemy, for the reward will be in the form of bad
names. Poor brethren must support themselves by begging
or by peddling, and must not become traitors. For the
sake of the existence of the nation and the welfare of
our descendants, we now warn you and advise you to repent
of your misdeeds at once.

Sign of five circles in chain order.
no. 5.
page_data.zh:
致背叛祖国的中国汉奸：

我们已被逼至生死存亡的最后关头。如果我们
前进，就会得救；如果我们后退，就会灭亡。中国士兵
的英勇事迹赢得了光荣的名声，震慑了敌人，并重新
唤醒了中华民族的民族魂。

在我们脚下的土地里，埋葬着我们祖先的尸骨。
为了区区小利，你们竟然背叛良心，成为无耻的汉奸。
你们真的愿意通过帮助敌人来加速祖国的灭亡吗？我们
确信最终能战胜敌人，但我们担心国家可能会因你们的
叛国行径而遭受挫败。

有钱人为敌人工作是不值得的，因为回报将是
恶名。贫穷的同胞必须靠乞讨或做小贩维持生计，绝不
能成为汉奸。为了国家的生存和我们后代的福祉，我们
现在警告你们，劝你们立即悔改罪行。

賊，然你的感九上滅亡你的祖國，我們戰勝敵人的好

有錢的人吃着何者接美好敗類的臭名
黃鼠狼問脫又要必沒則寒老逼說做小生意
你的老生活為了求國家的光榮子孫的幸福我們發誓

At the beginning of October, 1937, a People's National
Salvation Dramatic Group was formed by Messrs. Foo Kuo Shun
(傅國順), Wong Jan Ming (王仁民) and Sung Fang (宋方),
members of local dramatic circles, with the object of staging
plays of a national salvation nature in Shanghai. It had
an office at No.134 Route Remi which was closed on October 3,
1937, by order of the French Police.

At present this Group has a membership of 50 persons,
30 of whom are learning Mandarin between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m.
every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday at the Wu Zuh Primary
School, 246 Shanhaikwan Road, while the remaining 20 are rehear-
sing a play entitled "Revenge," between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. every
Monday, Wednesday and Friday at the Dah Kung Supplementary
School, No.17 Ying Tsung Terrace (穎村), Rue Lafayette.

The play in question contains only one act and is based
on a story in connection with the incident in Hongkew Park on
April 26, 1932, when a bomb exploded and killed and injured
a number of Japanese generals and diplomatic officers.

In the synopsis, only four players take part, three males and
one female representing respectively Mr. Ying Zang Chih (尹藏志),
a member of the Korean Youths' Party, Mr. Ching Chih Sung

clothes detective, and Miss Li Zang Lan (李藏蘭), Ying's

and Miss Li on the fate of Korea and the determination of Ying

民众救亡演剧队，目的是在上海上演救国性质的剧目。
该队在雷米路（Route Remi）134号设有办事处，但该处

（Rue Lafayette）颖村（Ying Tsung Terrace）17号大公
补习学校排练一出名为《复仇》的话剧。

发生的事件，当时一枚炸弹爆炸，造成多名日本将军和
外交官员伤亡。

代表韩国青年党成员尹藏志（Ying Zang Chih）先生、
